definition_en: increasing the value or earnings of a company
example_en: The acquisition is expected to be accretive to earnings.
example_uz: Xarid kompaniya daromadini oshirishi kutilmoqda.

definition_en: the practice of profiting from price differences
example_en: Traders used arbitrage between two markets.
example_uz: Trederlar ikki bozor orasidagi narx farqidan foydalandilar.

definition_en: the official examination of financial records
example_en: Auditing revealed several reporting errors.
example_uz: Audit tekshiruvi hisobotdagi bir nechta xatoni ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: a room where company directors meet
example_en: The decision was made in the boardroom.
example_uz: Qaror rahbariyat majlis xonasida qabul qilindi.

definition_en: the movement of money into and out of a business
example_en: Strong cashflow helps a firm pay its bills.
example_uz: Yaxshi pul oqimi firmaga hisoblarini to'lashga yordam beradi.

definition_en: to make a product similar to many competing products
example_en: Cheap imports can commoditize the market.
example_uz: Arzon importlar bozorni oddiy tovarlar bozoriga aylantirishi mumkin.

definition_en: the sale of part of a business or its assets
example_en: The divestiture allowed the firm to reduce debt.
example_uz: Aktivni sotish firmaga qarzni kamaytirishga imkon berdi.

definition_en: a claim or restriction on property or assets
example_en: The property has an encumbrance that delays the sale.
example_uz: Mulkdagi cheklov sotuvni kechiktirmoqda.

definition_en: able to be replaced by an identical item
example_en: Money is fungible because one note can replace another.
example_uz: Pul o'rnini bosish mumkin bo'lgan aktivdir.

definition_en: protection against loss or damage
example_en: The contract includes an indemnity clause.
example_uz: Shartnomada zararni qoplash kafolati bandi bor.

definition_en: the ability to turn assets into cash quickly
example_en: The company needs liquidity to meet short-term costs.
example_uz: Kompaniyaga qisqa muddatli xarajatlar uchun likvidlik kerak.

definition_en: the process of earning money from something
example_en: Monetization of the app began through subscriptions.
example_uz: Ilovani daromadga aylantirish obunalar orqali boshlandi.

definition_en: the act of deciding how much to charge
example_en: Pricing must reflect both costs and demand.
example_uz: Narx belgilash xarajat va talabni aks ettirishi kerak.

definition_en: a change in a company's debt and equity structure
example_en: Recapitalization gave the company more working capital.
example_uz: Kapitalni qayta shakllantirish kompaniyaga ko'proq aylanma mablag' berdi.

definition_en: the return of money or people to their home country
example_en: The firm planned the repatriation of overseas profits.
example_uz: Firma xorijdagi foydani vatanga qaytarishni rejaladi.

definition_en: the ability to pay debts
example_en: Regular profits improved the company's solvency.
example_uz: Muntazam foyda kompaniyaning to'lovga qodirligini oshirdi.

definition_en: a portion of money in a larger financial arrangement
example_en: The bank released the first tranche of funding.
example_uz: Bank mablag'ning birinchi qismini ajratdi.

definition_en: the process of accepting financial risk for a fee
example_en: Underwriting determines the cost of insurance.
example_uz: Riskni kafolatlash sug'urta narxini belgilaydi.

definition_en: the total value or financial structure of a company
example_en: The startup has a high market capitalization.
example_uz: Startapning bozor kapitallashuvi yuqori.

definition_en: the payment of money from a fund
example_en: The loan disbursement arrived this week.
example_uz: Kredit mablag'i to'lovi shu hafta yetib keldi.

definition_en: a person living and working outside their home country
example_en: The expatriate managed the regional office.
example_uz: Xorijda ishlovchi mutaxassis hududiy ofisni boshqardi.

definition_en: a service that buys a company's unpaid invoices
example_en: Factoring improved the supplier's cash position.
example_uz: Faktoring yetkazib beruvchining pul holatini yaxshiladi.

definition_en: the purchase of long-term export receivables
example_en: Forfaiting helped the exporter receive cash early.
example_uz: Forfeyting eksportchiga pulni ertaroq olishga yordam berdi.

definition_en: the state of being unable to pay debts
example_en: Insolvency forced the retailer to close stores.
example_uz: To'lovga qodirsizlik savdo tarmog'ini do'konlarni yopishga majbur qildi.

definition_en: a reduction in the selling price
example_en: The store offered a markdown on winter coats.
example_uz: Do'kon qishki paltolarga narx pasaytirdi.

definition_en: an amount of money spent
example_en: The initial outlay was higher than expected.
example_uz: Dastlabki xarajat kutilganidan yuqori bo'ldi.

definition_en: money sent to another person or place
example_en: The worker sends a monthly remittance home.
example_uz: Ishchi uyiga har oy pul jo'natmasi yuboradi.

definition_en: the conversion of assets into tradable securities
example_en: Securitization allowed the bank to sell its loans.
example_uz: Sekyuritizatsiya bankka kreditlarini sotishga imkon berdi.

definition_en: relating to financial risk calculations
example_en: Actuarial data guide pension decisions.
example_uz: Aktuar ma'lumotlar pensiya qarorlariga yo'l ko'rsatadi.

definition_en: an amount officially given to someone
example_en: Each department received an allotment for training.
example_uz: Har bir bo'lim trening uchun ajratilgan ulush oldi.

definition_en: a fixed amount paid regularly over time
example_en: Her annuity provides income after retirement.
example_uz: Uning annuiteti nafaqadan keyin daromad beradi.

definition_en: the division of something into shares
example_en: The apportionment of costs was agreed by both firms.
example_uz: Xarajatlarni ulushlab taqsimlash ikki firma tomonidan kelishildi.

definition_en: money officially set aside for a purpose
example_en: The budget includes an appropriation for research.
example_uz: Budjetda tadqiqot uchun mablag' ajratish bor.

definition_en: the act of finding out something for certain
example_en: Price ascertainment took several days.
example_uz: Narxni aniqlash bir necha kun oldi.

definition_en: able to be charged to a client
example_en: Consultants record every billable hour.
example_uz: Maslahatchilar mijozga hisoblanadigan har bir soatni qayd etadilar.

definition_en: the business or fee of a broker
example_en: The firm earns brokerage on each trade.
example_uz: Firma har bir savdodan vositachilik haqi oladi.

definition_en: recorded as a long-term asset
example_en: The software cost was capitalized as an asset.
example_uz: Dastur xarajati aktiv sifatida hisobga olindi.

definition_en: the use of assets as security for a loan
example_en: Collateralization reduced the lender's risk.
example_uz: Garov bilan ta'minlash qarz beruvchining riskini kamaytirdi.

definition_en: eligible for a sales commission
example_en: Only new sales are commissionable this quarter.
example_uz: Bu chorakda faqat yangi savdolarga komissiya to'lanadi.

definition_en: involving advice and discussion
example_en: The manager uses a consultative leadership style.
example_uz: Menejer maslahatlashuvga asoslangan rahbarlik usulidan foydalanadi.
